ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
test_cases_present: partial - AN10833 plus ISO/IEC 14443-1/2/3/4 define functional commands, register layouts, anti-collision flow, and timing tables that map directly to compliance test scenarios. ISO 10373-6 (the test methods for proximity cards) is the normative compliance test framework and is out of scope of this application note.
derived_compliance_test_categories: PICC Layer-3 reset on field exit / re-entry — POR threshold + state reset to IDLE.
REQA (0x26) → ATQA reply: verify 16-bit ATQA contents (bit-frame AC bitmap + UID size + proprietary).
WUPA (0x52) → ATQA from both IDLE and HALT states.
REQA from HALT shall NOT trigger ATQA (PICC ignores).
Cascade Level 1 anti-collision: SEL = 0x93 + bit-frame split + BCC verification.
Cascade Level 2 anti-collision: SEL = 0x95 with Cascade Tag 0x88 in UID-CL1[0].
Cascade Level 3 anti-collision: SEL = 0x97 for 10-byte UID PICCs.
Full SELECT (NVB = 0x70) → SAK reply with CRC_A; SAK b3 = 1 if more CLs follow.
BCC verification per CL: XOR of 4 UID bytes must match transmitted BCC.
Cascade Tag (0x88) presence in UID-CL1[0] only for 7- and 10-byte UID PICCs.
Random ID (RID) mode: UID0 = 0x08, UID1..UID3 differ between two consecutive POR events.
HLTA → HALT state transition; PICC silent for REQA but answers WUPA.
Multiple-PICC anti-collision: 2..N PICCs in field, each with distinct UID; PCD shall enumerate all without infinite loop.
Bit-frame collision injection: deliberately overlap two PICC UIDs at byte 2 bit 5; PCD shall resolve.
SAK b6 = 0 PICC + RATS: PCD shall NOT issue RATS, OR PICC shall ignore RATS.
SAK b6 = 1 PICC + RATS → ATS reply with TL + T0 + optional TA(1)/TB(1)/TC(1) + historical bytes.
ATS FSCI vs PCD FSDI: PCD shall not send I-Block payload exceeding PICC's advertised FSC.
ATS FWI: PCD shall wait at least FWT after I-Block transmission before declaring timeout.
T=CL I-Block round-trip with alternating block number.
T=CL R(NAK) → PCD retransmission with same block number.
T=CL S(WTX) request from PICC → PCD extension of FWT by multiplier ≤ 59.
T=CL S(DESELECT) from PCD → PICC enters HALT.
GetVersion command (0x60) on MIFARE Ultralight EV1 → 7-byte response; byte 2 b4:b0 should match documented HW Product Type.
GetVersion on MIFARE Plus EV1 → 7-byte response; byte 2 = 0xX2.
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire EV3 → 7-byte response; byte 2 = 0xX1.
GetVersion on MIFARE DESFire Light → byte 2 = 0xX8.
GetVersion on NTAG21x → byte 2 = 0xX4.
GetVersion on legacy MIFARE Classic 1K → command not supported; PICC returns error or NAK — host shall fall back to ATQA/SAK classification.
Type B REQB → ATQB (12 bytes); PUPI extracted.
Type B ATTRIB → PICC selection + parameter negotiation.
CRC_A injection: PCD transmits frame with deliberately wrong CRC_A; PICC shall silently ignore.
CRC_B injection: same on Type B.
Parity bit injection (Type A): PCD transmits frame with one parity bit wrong; PICC shall silently ignore.
Bit rate negotiation: PCD upgrades to 212 / 424 / 848 kbps via PPS after RATS.
Field-on guard time: PCD-side ≥ 5 ms after field-on before first REQA (PICC POR allowance).
Maximum operating range: PICC operation at H = Hmin = 1.5 A/m and Hmax = 7.5 A/m.
